contract: docs/design/beta_basics_2026-10-05.md BB1 + BB2 (A23-21: PC keyboard keys only, fixed pad layout, button names on touch-only devices): 17 actions with the BB1 default keys / pad buttons, Reserved and Allowed key sets, KeyMap collision rule (explicit first in Actions order, a taken explicit key -> '', a live default-only action whose default is taken -> '' and reported once per session, non-live actions hold no key, never wipe all keys), KeyLabel, SanitizeSettings (unknown keys dropped, sparse Keys, Sfx clamp + 0.1 step, finite numbers, bools, enums), DataService fills Settings without a Version bump, SettingsService (<= 1 argument, <= 16 top-level keys, Seq clamped 0..2^31, ready + 1 s rate limit, dropped calls answered with nothing, owner-only echo, push on PlayerReady), Keybinds (Get / ActionFor / Label / PadFor / SetLocal swap / Clear / Reset / Apply / Changed / Collisions / Capture / Dispatch / prompts) and the Settings client (pull at Start, one pending blob at max(now, lastSent + 1.05 s), Flush through the same slot, older echoes ignored, unsent changes kept, a blob the server drops without an answer re-sent through the same slot, at most 5 times in a row). Review fixes 2026-10-06: a non-live action's stale saved key never blanks a live action in SetLocal; potion badges, quest-row key tokens and the in-flight resend are checked (static / offline).
limitations: Offline doubles: virtual clock for os.clock / task.delay, cached EnumItems, remotes with a fixed or scripted latency, DataStore table, Panels.Has from a registered-window set, UIKit.Toast recorder. HUD / VitalsUI / GrudgeGhost / WorldMap / Panels / StoryQuestService wiring is only checked statically. Not certified here: real key presses in Studio, which non-letter keys Roblox swallows, whether ProximityPrompt accepts a changed KeyboardKeyCode, real DataStore saves across rejoins, multiple clients.
